classes.name: CostReportsPage
classes.description:
# Cost Reports Page
Represents the "Time and costs" / "Cost reports" page in OpenProject.
This page allows users to create filtered reports of time and cost entries.
It includes filter, group-by, and units sections, plus action buttons (Apply, Save, Clear).

methods.name: clickApply
methods.description: Clicks the "Apply" link to run the report with current filters.

methods.name: clickClear
methods.description: Clicks the "Clear" link to reset all filters.

methods.name: clickSave
methods.description: Clicks the "Save" link to save the current report.

methods.name: hasReportData
methods.description: Returns true if the report table is visible (has data).

methods.name: hasNoDataMessage
methods.description: Returns true if the "nothing to display" message is shown.

methods.name: getReportHeading
methods.description: Returns the report heading text (e.g. "New cost report").

methods.name: costReportTable
methods.description:
Returns the cost report table component for reading report data.
Only call this when the report has data (after clickApply).

methods.name: selectLaborUnits
methods.description: Selects "Labor" as the units option.

methods.name: selectCashValueUnits
methods.description: Selects "Cash value" as the units option.

methods.name: removeDateFilter
methods.description:
Removes the date filter by clicking its "Remove filter" link.
This broadens the report to show all dates.

classes.name: CostReportTableComp
classes.description:
# Cost Report Table Component
Represents the result table in the cost reports page.
Shows time/cost data grouped by the configured rows and columns.

methods.name: getNumberOfDataRows
methods.description: Returns the number of data rows in the report table (excludes header and footer rows).

methods.name: isWorkPackageInReport
methods.description: Checks if a work package with the given subject appears in the report.

methods.name: getHoursForWorkPackage
methods.description: Returns the hours value for a specific work package row.

methods.name: getTotalHours
methods.description: Returns the total hours shown in the footer row.

classes.name: LogTimeDialogComp
classes.description:
# Log Time Dialog Component
Represents the "Log time" dialog that appears when logging time on a work package.
Contains fields: User, Date, Hours, Activity, and Comment.

methods.name: fillHours
methods.description: Fills in the hours field.

methods.name: fillDate
methods.description: Fills in the date field.

methods.name: fillComment
methods.description: Fills in the comment field.

methods.name: selectActivity
methods.description: Selects an activity from the dropdown by visible text.

methods.name: clickLogButton
methods.description:
Clicks the "Log" button to submit the time entry.
Waits for the dialog to close after submission.

methods.name: clickCancelButton
methods.description: Clicks the "Cancel" button to dismiss the dialog.

methods.name: logTime
methods.signature: logTime(hours: string, activity: string, comment?: string): Promise<void>
methods.description: Logs time in a single call: fills hours, selects activity, optionally sets comment, and submits.
